name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +2

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain a Pact Magic slot
powers.text: Magic action: regain one expended Pact Magic spell slot (once per Long Rest).

summary: +2 to your Warlock spell attacks and save DC; once per Long Rest, regain a Pact Magic slot.
text: Holding this rod, your Warlock spells get +2 on their spell attack rolls and to their save DCs. Also while holding it, you can take a Magic action to recover one expended Pact Magic spell slot; that property then recharges when you finish a Long Rest.
